title: Best Long Weekend Getaways from Delhi
content:
Escape the Hustle, Discover the Weekend Magic

Life in Delhi can be fast, exciting, and exhausting - which is why a long weekend getaway feels like a breath of fresh air. Luckily, Delhi’s central location makes it a perfect launch pad for incredible short trips across North India.

From misty hill stations in Himachal and Uttarakhand to majestic heritage cities in Rajasthan and wildlife sanctuaries teeming with nature, this ultimate guide brings together every type of trip you can dream of - all within a few hours’ drive from the capital.

Whether you’re a family planner, a couple looking for peace, or a solo traveler chasing new experiences, this guide will help you find the perfect weekend destination - and plan it effortlessly.

Long Weekend Destinations from Delhi & Choose Your Kind of Getaway

1.Hill Stations - Shimla, Mussoorie, Nainital, Kasauli, Lansdowne. 

Perfect for: Peace lovers, couples, and nature seekers
Beat the city heat and escape into the serene hills. From Shimla’s colonial charm to Lansdowne’s quiet pine forests, these destinations are ideal for 2-4 day holidays.

Explore Hill Station Near Delhi.. click here 

 

 

2. Heritage & Culture Trips - Jaipur, Agra, Neemrana, Mandawa

Perfect for: History enthusiasts, families, photographers
Walk through royal palaces, ancient forts, and colorful markets. Discover the rich heritage of Rajasthan and Mughal architecture of Agra in this fascinating route.

Explore Heritage Getaways Near Delhi.. click here 

 

 

3. Wildlife & Nature Escapes - Jim Corbett, Sariska, Ranthambore, Bharatpur

Perfect for: Adventure seekers, nature lovers, families
Witness India’s wild side up close. From tiger safaris in Sariska to birdwatching in Bharatpur, these trips reconnect you with nature’s beauty.

Explore Wildlife Destination Near Delhi…click here

 

 

4. Offbeat Escapes & Hidden Gems- Tirthan, Jibhi, Chopta, Binsar

Perfect for: Explorers, photographers, backpackers
Skip the crowded places and find peace in lesser-known valleys like Jibhi, Chopta, and Binsar. Experience local life, homestays, and untouched landscapes.

Uncover Offbeat Escapes.. click here 

 

 

5. Adventure & Activity Trips- Rishikesh, Bir Billing, Chopta.

Perfect for: Young travelers, thrill-seekers, group outings
Try river rafting in Rishikesh, paragliding in Bir Billing, or camping under the stars in Chopta. Plan a trip packed with adrenaline and fun.

Plan Adventure Trips.. click here

 

 

6. Short & Relaxing Escapes (Within 200 km)

Perfect for: Couples, weekend relaxation, family breaks
If you only have 1-2 days, choose nearby spots like Neemrana, Sohna, or Murthal. Enjoy spa resorts, scenic drives, and delicious food getaways.

See Short Weekend Trips.. click here

Travel Tips for Long Weekend Trips

  • Leave early morning to avoid traffic.
  • Pack light layers - weather can change fast in the hills.
  • Book hotels in advance during public holidays.
  • Keep offline maps downloaded for remote areas.
  • Try local cuisine wherever you go - every region has its own flavor!

faqs.question: What are the best long weekend trips from Delhi?
faqs.answer: Top options include Rishikesh, Jaipur, Agra, Shimla, Mussoorie, Kasauli, Neemrana, Sariska, and offbeat destinations like Chopta and Tirthan Valley.

faqs.question: How far can I travel from Delhi for a long weekend?
faqs.answer: You can comfortably travel within a range of 200-400 km for a 2-3 day trip. Longer trips up to 600 km are possible for 4-day weekends.

faqs.question: Which hill stations are nearest to Delhi?
faqs.answer: Popular nearby hill stations include Shimla, Mussoorie, Kasauli, Lansdowne, and Nainital.

faqs.question: What is the best time to plan a long weekend trip from Delhi?
faqs.answer: : The best months are March-June (pleasant weather) and September-December (cool climate), avoiding heavy monsoon rains.

faqs.question: Can I do a long weekend trip from Delhi without a car?
faqs.answer: Yes, many destinations have direct trains, buses, and flights. However, having a car offers more flexibility to explore.

faqs.question: What are the best long weekend getaways from Delhi?
faqs.answer: Popular long weekend destinations from Delhi include Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Nainital, Jim Corbett, Jaipur, Agra, Lansdowne, Shimla, Kasol, and Chandigarh.
